annual.title: FY 2024-25 Colorado DOI Annual Complaint & Recoveries Report
annual.note: Recoveries are money restored to consumers. The closed figure of 7,792 is complaints and inquiries together and includes 222 inquiries. That mixed grain is not published as a complaint-only total. The annual report does not state a single statewide confirmed-complaint count.

standard_ratio_index.inclusion_rule: five or more complaints OR at least 0.1% of premium volume in a line
standard_ratio_index.ratio_definition: total received complaints per $1 million premium in that line
standard_ratio_index.index_definition: (company share of complaints) / (company share of premium) in that line; 1.0 is average

interactive_ratio_index.inclusion_rule: any Colorado insurance premium written OR at least one complaint

verify.explains: Colorado DOI points consumers to Sircon for live license inquiry. A lookup hit is not a TrustHub profile and is not a bulk roster. Existing InsuranceTrustHub insurer/agency research tools remain national graph tools, not a substitute for Colorado DOI verification.

findings.title: The 2025 statistical report is a dated market report, not a live authorized roster
findings.summary: The NAIC Companies tab has 1,839 company directory rows and 1,839 distinct NAIC CoCodes after excluding a legend row. That grain is as-of 2025-12-31.
doesNotMean: the official PDF narrative of 1,844 premium-writing companies is the same denominator

findings.title: Eligible non-admitted surplus-lines identities are a separate grain
findings.summary: The official 2026–2027 list has 259 eligible identities (225 NAIC + 34 alien AA-), effective 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30, updated 2026-07-24. The 2025–2026 list (247 identities through 2026-06-30) is historical.
doesNotMean: alien AA- identities are NAIC CoCodes
the expired 2025–2026 list is current eligibility

findings.title: Colorado DOI publishes a source-native Complaint Ratio and Complaint Index
findings.summary: The 2025 standard reports are bounded company-by-line tables with NAIC CoCodes on official detail links. DOI calculates ratio and index from all received complaints, not confirmed-only. That regulator metric is not a TrustHub score, ranking, or quality grade.
doesNotMean: a low index is a TrustHub declaration of a good insurer
zero complaints in one year/line is a universal clean history
